lines.text: Many learners say: I have studied English since three years.
Better: I have studied English for three years.
For! I have lived here for two years.

data.wrong: I have studied English since three years.
data.right: I have studied English for three years.

quiz.stem: I have lived here ___ two years.

native.tip: Türkçede “üç yıldır” deriz; süre için İngilizcede “for” kullanılır: “I have studied English for three years.”
native.caption: “I have studied English since three years” mi diyorsun? 😅 Süre anlatırken “since” değil, “for” kullanılır. Doğrusu “I have studied English for three years.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “for”. “Üç yıldır” için “for three years” de. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: “For” shows how long: “I have studied English for three years.”
en.caption: Do you say “I have studied English since three years”? 😅 In English for shows how long, and since shows a start point. The right sentence is “I have studied English for three years.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
